about: Voice order E2E on /demo through the kibo-voice relay to Vertex AI Live (relay mode of e2e/voice.live.spec.ts, `npm run test:e2e:live`): GEMINI_LIVE_BACKEND=vertex; the relay and a dev server run in one local process (scripts/e2e-relay-stack.ts), so the browser → relay hop is local, not Cloud Run; Vertex AI in VOICE_VERTEX_LOCATION or us-central1. Synthetic TTS voice (Gemini TTS, e2e/fixtures) through Chromium's fake microphone on a laptop, not a real phone. End of speech = the last voiced 40 ms mic frame sent to Live before the model's first output; the page sends the looping fixture once. (a) end of speech → first AI audio chunk; (b) end of speech → first 2 s highlight ring on the kiosk half. Medians over passing runs.
